parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism when pressed, releasing water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the toilet tank, usually made of molded plastic or ceramic.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the tank to prevent debris from entering and provides a finished appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or removed for maintenance or cleaning.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic for durability and hygiene.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure anchored to the floor.
